description: Source code for HuggingFace API provider class, implementing message creation, prompt completion, and model info retrieval using OpenAI SDK and HuggingFace models.

classes.name: HuggingFaceHandler
classes.description: A class that handles interactions with HuggingFace models, including message creation and prompt completion.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the HuggingFaceHandler with provided options, sets up API client, and fetches models.

methods.name: fetchModels
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches available HuggingFace models and updates the cache.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream based on system prompt and messages, handling streaming responses.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the HuggingFace model and returns the generated text.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves model information, either from cache or default values.
